title: UK PM Keir Starmer says X indicated to government officials it was acting to comply with UK laws by restricting the generation of non-consensual sexual images (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: UK PM Keir Starmer says X indicated to government officials it was acting to comply with UK laws by restricting the generation of non-consensual sexual images — UK prime minister says xAI will restrict the image generator as billionaire pledges to follow laws in all markets
